18.headline: Dončić drops 46 on the 1 seed, and the race tightens
18.dek: Manhattan won at Stony Brook with three rotation players out, Toronto climbed to the 2 seed, and Cambridge's fifth straight win left it one game out of the 4 seed at the halfway mark.

games.text: Manhattan showed up at the 1 seed's building without Karl-Anthony Towns, Damian Lillard or Kon Knueppel, and it did not matter, because Luka Dončić was there. He scored 46 points on 17-of-25 shooting with 13 assists, and the Elephants won the fourth quarter 31-20 to beat Stony Brook 115-104. The game was tied at 84 after three. Manhattan stays the 4 seed at 10-8. The Stingrays are still the 1 seed, now by a single game.

The 2 seed belongs to Toronto now. The Jays scored 39 in the first quarter, won the third 33-18 and beat Waltham 120-105 behind Jaylen Brown's 27 points and 10 rebounds. Jayson Tatum made nine 3-pointers and scored 31 for the Bears, which is a lot of work for a 15-point loss. Waltham has dropped three straight and slid from the 5 seed to the 7 seed.

Cambridge started the season looking like a lottery team. It is 9-9 after a fifth straight win, a 116-91 dismantling of Durham that was 63-39 at halftime. Victor Wembanyama scored 27 and Herbert Jones made five of his six 3-pointers. The Destroyers, missing Jamal Murray, got 17 from Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and fell from the 2 seed to the 3 seed. The Platypuses are the 6 seed, one game back of the playoff line.

Sixteen lead changes, and then Ithaca simply stopped giving it back. Deni Avdija scored 28 and Nikola Jokić did the accounting, with 18 points, 14 rebounds and 13 assists, in a 114-106 win at Queens. The Thunder moved up to the 5 seed with the same 10-8 record as the two teams directly above them. The Pigeons, who got 21 from Jalen Green and not much else, remain the 8 seed.

Somebody had to win the game between the 9 seed and the 10 seed. Tyrese Haliburton made seven 3-pointers and scored 29, Kawhi Leonard added 25, and Gooning beat Rochester 117-105 after trailing by 11. Evan Mobley had 23 points and 10 assists for the Dragons, who played without Paolo Banchero and Tyler Herro, have lost three in a row and are 5-13.
